question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank no. 1.
solution:
The correct answer is "began."

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** 

__
 
• The word **"began" **is used in the blank because it denotes the start or commencement of the 2020 Tokyo Olympics.
 
• As it happened in the past, so must use V2 form of the verb **"begin"** here.
 
• In this context, you're describing the time period when the build-up to the Olympics started.
 
• The use of** "began"** helps convey the chronological sequence of events in a clear and accurate manner.
 
• Hence, option 3 is the correct answer.
 
• Correct paragraph: 

The build up to the 2020 Tokyo Olympics, which **began**__ on July 23 and finished on August 8, as defined by cautious optimism, as well as a slew of ______ (2) ______ that came with staging the Games under tight safety standards and without ______ (3) ______ during the COVID-19 outbreak. While Indian competitors had shown enough potential to ______ (4) ______ expect a big return of medals in the Games, the disappointments of Rio 2016 lingered. What happened was that India delivered its best-ever performance at the Games, beginning with Mirabai Chanu's silver medal in weightlifting on the first day and culminating with Neeraj Chopra's ______ (5) ______ gold medal in javelin throw on the country's last day of competition in Tokyo.
